name: Giant Rats
notes: 2d6 rats.

name: Goblin Band
notes: 1d6 goblins ambush from cover.

name: Skeleton Guard
notes: Mindless. Resistant to piercing and edged, vulnerable to blunt.

name: Orc Patrol
notes: 1d4 warriors demanding blood or toll.

name: Ghoul
notes: Two claws and a bite; any hit forces a Body save or Paralyzed. Mindless. Tell: gnawed bones and a carrion stink. Want: fresh meat, living or not.

name: Giant Spider
notes: Poison on a hit (Body save). Webs: Dodge save or stuck 1d4 rounds.

name: Rival Adventurers
notes: 1d4+1 NPCs of the party's Level, one per class. Roll Reaction.

name: Dark Cultist
notes: Casts Cause Light Wounds for 1d8 on a touch. Chaotic.

name: Ogre
notes: Heavy club. Keeps a crude hoard. Tell: a reeking club and a tally of skulls. Want: food, bright coin, or a fight it can win.

name: Wight
notes: Drain on a hit (Body save or Injured). Silver or magic only. Mindless. Tell: a barrow chill, and its victims rising behind it. Want: to drag you under, and it rarely talks.
trick: Silver or magic weapons only.

name: Troll
notes: Two claws and a bite. Regeneration 3 each round unless the wound was fire or acid. Tell: wounds knitting shut as you watch. Want: a toll of meat, or your slowest companion.
trick: Regenerates each round; only fire or acid keeps it down.

name: Young Dragon
notes: Fear on first sight (Will save). Breath 6d6 fire in 30 ft, Dodge for half. Immune to fire. Tell: scorched ground, a sulphur reek, bones picked clean. Want: tribute, flattery, or word of a richer hoard.
trick: Immune to fire; take the breath on a Dodge, then close so it cannot line up another.

name: Gargoyle
notes: Flies. Mindless. Silver or magic only. Tell: stone that waits stock-still until you pass. Want: tribute, or just to guard its roost.
trick: Silver or magic only; plain steel skids off stone.

name: Engine Guardian
notes: A gargoyle grown fat on stray magic. Will not leave its post.

name: Restless Sailor
notes: Chilling touch. Silver or magic only. Passive unless disturbed.

name: Animated Rigging
notes: Grab: Dodge save or stuck 1d4 rounds. Mindless. Fire frees the caught.

name: Wick the Pseudodragon
notes: Sting: Body save or Asleep. Flies. A friend, not a fight, once fed.

name: Gargoyle Chieftain
notes: Flies. Mindless. Silver or magic only. Proud, and open to tribute.

name: Harpy
notes: Flies. Song: Will save or walk toward it, even off a ledge, until struck. Tell: a sweet song on the wind you cannot place. Want: to lure and feast, but it hushes for shiny trade.

name: Wraith-Librarian
notes: Drain on a hit (Body save or Injured). Silver or magic only. Hushes a caster for 1d4 rounds (Will save).

name: Clockwork Sentinel
notes: Mindless. Vulnerable to lightning.

name: Thalros the Cloud Giant
notes: Slam. Thunder-call: a 20 ft burst, Dodge save or 3d6 and shoved to the deck's edge.

name: Kobold
notes: Scheming and cowardly. Warrens of 4d6, thick with traps. Breaks morale fast.

name: Hobgoblin
notes: Disciplined soldier. 1d6 patrol under a 2 HD sergeant.

name: Bugbear
notes: Surprise despite its bulk. Hits like an ogre.

name: Gnoll
notes: Hyena-headed raiders. 1d6 pack, cruel to captives. Tell: hyena laughter and captives roped in a line. Want: loot, slaves, or a cut of your spoils.

name: Lizardfolk
notes: Swamp hunters. Hold their breath 10 turns. 2d4 near water. Tell: reed nests and fish-bones at the water edge. Want: their eggs safe, or tribute of fish and meat.

name: Berserker
notes: Berserk, so +2 more to hit; never breaks and fights to the death. 1d6 frenzied raiders, heedless of wounds. Tell: old scars, a foaming fury, a warband that will not stop. Want: slaughter and glory, seldom plunder.

name: Hill Giant
notes: Hurls rocks 60 ft for 2d8. Keeps a cave hoard.

name: Stone Giant
notes: Hurls boulders 120 ft for 3d6, and can catch one thrown back.

name: Frost Giant
notes: Immune to cold. Hurls ice for 2d10.

name: Fire Giant
notes: Immune to fire. Hurls burning rock for 2d10.

name: Zombie
notes: Mindless and slow, always acts last.

name: Wraith
notes: Drain on a hit. Flies. Silver or magic only. Mindless.
trick: Silver or magic only; kill it fast before it drains your Levels.

name: Spectre
notes: Drains two Levels on a hit. Flies. Magic only. Mindless.
trick: Magic weapons only; it drains two Levels a hit.

name: Mummy
notes: Slam. A hit brings the mummy's rot, a wasting death as the Cause Disease spell, and no wound it dealt will close till Cure Disease lifts it. The sight of it Frightens (Will save). Mindless. Fire or magic weapons only. Tell: dry rot, bandage dust, a curse cut over the door. Want: its tomb left undisturbed.
trick: Only fire or a magic weapon bites it; its rot kills as Cause Disease unless Cure Disease stays it.

name: Vampire
notes: Drain on a hit. Charm gaze (Will save). Regeneration 3. Becomes mist or a bat. A stake, sunlight, or running water undoes it; else magic only. Tell: no reflection, a graveyard cold, charmed thralls. Want: blood, servants, and its secret kept.
trick: A stake, sunlight, or running water undoes it; else it reforms.

name: Wolf
notes: 2d6 pack. Harries and surrounds. Breaks if the leader falls.

name: Dire Wolf
notes: Great pack-hunter. 1d4+1 run together.

name: Brown Bear
notes: Two claws and a bite. A hug for 2d8 more if both claws land.

name: Boar
notes: Charges. Fights on for a round past 0 HP.

name: Giant Bat
notes: Flies. A swarm fouls the air: -2 to anyone within.

name: Giant Centipede
notes: A bite brings weak venom: Body save or Diseased, as it only sickens.

name: Constrictor Snake
notes: A hit coils: automatic 1d6 each round until a STR Check breaks the grip.

name: Stirge
notes: Flies. Blood Drain: latches on a hit, 1d3 each round until torn off.

name: Giant Scorpion
notes: Two claws and a sting. Sting Poison (Body save).

name: Giant Toad
notes: Tongue 10 ft drags you in; the next bite hits free. Swallows a small creature.

name: Green Slime
notes: Drops from above. Devours flesh and wood: fire or a STR Check scrapes it off before it eats through. Only fire and cold kill it. Mindless.
trick: Only fire and cold kill it; a blade or bare hand just feeds it.

name: Grey Ooze
notes: Like wet stone. Rust: corrodes metal on a hit. Immune to cold and lightning. Mindless.

name: Ochre Jelly
notes: Split by a blunt or edged blow, each half the HP. Fire or cold kills it whole. Mindless.
trick: Blunt or edged blows split it; only fire or cold kills it whole.

name: Gelatinous Cube
notes: Fills a corridor, near-invisible: Surprise. A hit Paralyzes (Body save) and swallows. Immune to lightning. Mindless. Tell: a too-clean hall, with bones hanging in the air. Want: nothing, so just do not walk into it.
trick: Near-invisible: prod ahead with a pole or the lead walker is swallowed.

name: Black Pudding
notes: Dissolves metal and wood. Splits under blows like an ochre jelly; only fire harms it whole. Mindless.
trick: It splits under blows and eats metal; only fire harms it whole.

name: Owlbear
notes: Two claws and a bite, a hug for 2d8 more if both claws land. Never checks morale. Tell: torn trees and drifting feathers mark its ground. Want: nothing but its range, though it can be drawn off.

name: Rust Monster
notes: Rust: a touch corrodes metal armor or a weapon to flakes. It wants iron, not blood. Tell: it passes over flesh and noses toward your iron. Want: your metal, so feed it a spare blade to pass.
trick: It devours metal; strike with wood, stone, or fists or lose your gear.

name: Carrion Crawler
notes: Eight tentacles, each a strike at +3; any hit Paralyzes (Body save) 1d4 rounds, then it feeds.

name: Cockatrice
notes: Flies. A peck Petrifies (Body save).
trick: A touch petrifies; keep it at spear reach.

name: Basilisk
notes: Gaze Petrifies (Body save). Turn its own gaze on it with a mirror. Tell: creatures frozen mid-step around its lair. Want: only to feed, though a mirror turns it.
trick: Its gaze petrifies; avert your eyes at -4, or turn it with a mirror.

name: Medusa
notes: Gaze Petrifies (Body save). Snake-hair Poison. Fight her blind at -4. Tell: terror-faced statues, and she keeps veiled. Want: to be left alone, or a gift of fine things.
trick: Its gaze turns flesh to stone; fight with averted eyes at -4, or a mirror.

name: Minotaur
notes: Gore and bite. Never lost in a maze. Charges for double damage. Tell: tally-scratched walls and a bellow down the maze. Want: to keep its maze, though a true way out may turn it.

name: Manticore
notes: Flies. Two claws and a bite in reach. Looses 1d6 tail spikes 90 ft, 1d6 each.

name: Chimera
notes: Flies. Three heads strike together. The dragon head breathes fire 3d6 (Dodge for half).

name: Wyvern
notes: Flies. Tail sting Poison: Body save or Poisoned and 2d6 more.

name: Hydra
notes: Bites once per living head, eight at full, each +8 for 1d10. A head falls to 8 damage in one blow; two regrow unless the stump is burned.
trick: Each head attacks; cut or burn them down one at a time.

name: Gorgon
notes: Iron-scaled bull. Breath Petrifies in a 60 ft cone (Body save).
trick: Its breath petrifies in a cone; scatter and take it from the flank.

name: Griffon
notes: Flies. Two claws and a bite. Hunts horses above all.

name: Unicorn
notes: Horn and hooves. Immune to Charmed and Poison. Its horn cures. Serves only the pure.

name: Werewolf
notes: Silver or magic only. A bite may pass the curse. A man by day.
trick: Silver or magic only; a bite may pass the curse.

name: Wererat
notes: Silver or magic only. Commands rats and slips into shadow.

name: Dryad
notes: Charm (Will save) to lure you deep into the wood. Dies if her tree dies.

name: Pixie
notes: Flies. Invisible at will, often unseen until it strikes.

name: Centaur
notes: Hooves and a bow. 2d10 roam the open plains.

name: Fire Elemental
notes: Sets all it touches alight. Immune to fire; water wounds it. Cannot cross water.
trick: Immune to fire; water wounds it, and it cannot cross a stream.

name: Earth Elemental
notes: Rises from stone and moves through it. Slow but relentless. Cannot cross water.

name: Dragon
notes: Flies. Fear on sight (Will save). Breath once in 1d4 rounds: 10d6 in a 40 ft cone or line (Dodge for half), of its element, fire, frost, acid, lightning, or gas, which it is immune to. Claws and bite, or a breath, each round. A vast hoard, and cunning enough to bargain. Scale by age: a wyrmling near HD 5, a great wyrm HD 14 with breath to match. Tell: the reek of its element and a mountain of plundered gold. Want: tribute, flattery, and its hoard untouched.
trick: Immune to its own element; survive the breath, deny it the line for another, or bargain.

name: Treant
notes: Two slams. Wakes 1d2 nearby trees to fight at its side. Vulnerable to fire. Looks a weathered tree until it steps. Tell: a grove gone silent, deep-pressed roots like footfalls. Want: the wood unharmed; axe or torch makes a patient enemy.

name: Lich
notes: A dead archmage, cunning and cold. Casts as a Magic-User of its HD, the full book. Touch: 1d10 and a Body save or Paralyzed. Fear on sight (Will save). Silver or magic only. Its life hides in a phylactery; unmade, it reforms in days unless that is found and broken. Tell: a chill that gutters small flames, coal-light in a dry skull. Want: lore, the dead multiplied, and its phylactery kept secret.
trick: Cut down, it reforms in days unless its phylactery is found and broken.

name: Roc
notes: Flies. A titan eagle. Two talons and a bite; a talon hit snatches a rider or mount aloft, STR Check or be carried off and dropped. Nests on high crags among bright wreckage. Tell: a shadow sweeping the fields, herds gone in the night. Want: meat and glittering things for the nest.

name: Pegasus
notes: Flies. A noble winged horse, shy of the cruel and the loud. Two hooves. Will bear a rider it judges worthy, won by patience, never by force. Tell: hoofprints that run to a cliff and lift away. Want: to stay wild, or be gentled by a kind hand.

name: Sphinx
notes: Flies. Lion-bodied, grave, and old. Sets a riddle: answer true and it may aid you or wave you past; answer false and it falls on you. Roar once a day: all within 30 ft Body save or Weakened for the fight, ears ringing. Tell: a riddle cut into the pass, bones of wrong answers beneath. Want: a riddle well met, or a finer one in trade.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
notes: Flies and darts, almost impossible to strike (AC 18). A bobbing light that lures travelers into bog and mire, then feeds on their terror as they sink. Can snuff itself dark to vanish. Tell: a warm lantern where no road or house stands. Want: to drown you, and drink the fear of it.
trick: It lures you into the mire; ignore the light and it finds no prey.

name: Riding Horse
notes: 60 ft, double that on the road. Will not stand in a fight; a panic kick is 1d4, and it bolts at blood, fire, or a monster's roar.

name: War Pony
notes: 40 ft. War-trained and surefooted in hill and mountain. Two hooves.

name: Light Warhorse
notes: 60 ft. War-trained and fast, the scout's and skirmisher's mount. Two hooves.

name: Medium Warhorse
notes: 50 ft. The common cavalry mount, war-trained. Two hooves and a bite.

name: Heavy Warhorse
notes: 40 ft. The destrier, bred for the lance and the charge. Two hooves and a bite.

name: Mule
notes: 40 ft. Stubborn and surefooted, hauls a load where a horse balks. A kick for 1d4.

name: Camel
notes: 40 ft. Keeps the desert and goes long without water. Spits, bites, and kicks for 1d4.
